description: This vehicle is located at our Indianapolis facility - 2461 Reeves Rd #194, Plainfield, IN 46168    GR Auto Gallery is pleased to present this exceptionally original 1990 Ford Mustang LX 5.0 for your consideration. Finished in its factory Black paint over Titanium Gray articulated leather sport seats, this Fox Body is exactly the kind of well-preserved example enthusiasts have been searching for. Showing just 50,000 original miles, this Mustang has had only two owners since new and spent the majority of its life in the dry climate of Texas before coming to Indiana. Accompanying the car are both the original window sticker and a Deluxe Marti Report, documenting its factory equipment, production history, and authenticity.  Power comes from Ford's legendary 5.0L High Output sequential fuel-injected V8, backed by a professionally rebuilt four-speed automatic overdrive transmission. Equipped from the factory with the desirable 3.27 Traction-Lok rear axle, this Mustang delivers the unmistakable performance and sound that made the Fox Body an American icon. Recent maintenance includes a complete tune-up with new spark plugs, spark plug wires, distributor cap, and rotor, giving the car a strong, smooth-running foundation for its next owner. Two new tires have been installed, the front end has been professionally aligned, and a new sunroof gasket has also been fitted.  Factory options make this LX especially desirable. According to the Marti Report, it was ordered with the flip-up power sunroof, Titanium Gray leather articulated sport seats, premium sound system with AM/FM cassette and clock, power windows, power door locks, cruise control, dual power mirrors, air conditioning, leather-wrapped steering wheel, speed control, light group, and tinted glass. The car now rides on an attractive set of upgraded wheels that complement the timeless Fox Body styling while maintaining a clean, period-correct appearance.  The included Marti Report shows this Mustang was built on March 30, 1990ten days ahead of scheduleand originally sold through Montross Ford-Mercury in Virginia before relocating to Texas in 2004, where it remained for over two decades. The CARFAX is equally impressive, showing no reported accidents, no structural damage, no airbag deployments, no salvage history, and no open recalls. The report does note a mileage inconsistency from a later inspection entry, which appears consistent with a simple clerical input error, as the documented service history supports the vehicle's low-mileage condition.  As Fox Body Mustangs continue to climb in popularity among collectors, documented, low-mileage, two-owner examples like this become increasingly difficult to find. With its original documentation, desirable factory options, Texas history, recent mechanical servicing, and legendary 5.0L V8, this 1990 Mustang LX is equally at home in a collection, at local shows, or out on the open road where it belongs. The 2.5L I-4 Hybrid engine achieves an impressive 42 city and 33 highway MPG, making every trip to the fuel pump less frequent and your wallet happier.  - XLT Luxury Package with leather-wrapped heated steering wheel - Heated front seats with 8-way power driver seat - Remote start system with windshield wiper de-icer - Ford Co-Pilot360 with blind spot monitoring and lane-keeping alert - Spray-in bedliner with bed tie-down locking rails - Heated power mirrors with body-color caps - Trailer hitch receiver with 4-pin connector - LED box lighting and manual rear sliding window - Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration - Rear backup camera and electronic stability control - 17-inch aluminum wheels - Automatic temperature control with dual-zone capability  This Ford Blue Certified vehicle comes backed by comprehensive support and protection. You'll receive a 139-point inspection, roadside assistance, and a transferable limited warranty covering three months or 4,000 miles. The $100 warranty deductible provides affordable peace of mind, and you'll earn 11,000 FordPass Rewards Points toward your first maintenance visit. Ford Blue Advantage extends certification benefits across Ford and non-Ford models, giving you confidence in your purchase.  The cabin reflects careful attention to comfort and connectivity. Automatic headlights, steering wheel-mounted audio controls, and a trip computer keep you informed and in command. Power windows, remote keyless entry, and an overhead console add convenience to daily driving. The front bucket seats with center armrest provide comfortable seating for extended journeys.  Safety is engineered throughout this truck. Dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags work with ABS brakes, electronic stability control, and traction control to help protect you and your passengers. The lane-keeping alert system and blind spot information system with cross-traffic alert add an extra layer of awareness on the road.  The Maverick XLT proves you don't need to compromise between capability and efficiency. Whether you're using the truck bed for weekend projects or commuting to the office, this hybrid delivers practicality without sacrificing fuel economy.
